title: fix(fields): a dependsOn lookup filters by a populated parent's id, not "[object Object]"
body:
Fixes #36837

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录详情页（以及编辑弹窗）里点一个依赖上级查找字段的选择器（例如报价单的「联系人」按所属客户过滤）时，原来永远显示「未找到选项」，现在能列出该客户下的联系人。
- 属于表单级联选择（依赖字段过滤）这一核心能力，替产品负责人报告的报价单场景解决。
- 若有误，最坏情况是依赖过滤取错值导致选择器为空，与修复前相同；改动只在一处，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

A lookup with `dependsOn` naming another lookup builds its candidate filter from the record the host hands it (`dependentValues`). A record page hands the record as the server returned it, so the parent lookup arrives **populated** (`{ id, name, … }`). The one place that turns that record into the filter, `LookupField`'s `dependentFilter` memo, did `String(v)` on it. The request then carried `["crm_account","=","[object Object]"]` and the picker never matched.

`dependentFilter` now collapses the parent value through `collapseReference`. That is the rule `lookupRecordReference.ts` already applies to `{ $record }` filter comparands ("an expanded row collapses to its id"), now exported so both candidate-filter readers share it. It is fixed at that one producer. All four candidate surfaces read the same memo, so all four are fixed: the quick-select popover, the Level-2 table picker, the PeoplePicker and the create-new seed (`initialValues` / inline `create`). The fix applies whatever the host is: detail inline edit, header highlight, in-place editor or the record form. A bare-id parent is unchanged.

Files:
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`: the `dependentFilter` memo collapses each parent value; an import is added.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupRecordReference.ts`: `collapseReference` is exported and its doc names both readers.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.dependsOn.test.tsx`: a new top-level `describe` in the existing dependsOn harness.
- `.changeset/36837-dependson-lookup-id.md`: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

## Tests

- New pin "a populated dependsOn parent scopes by its id (objectstack#36837)":
  - The populated parent `{ account: { id: 'a1', name: 'Acme' } }` must put `$filter.account === 'a1'` on every `find` call, and the list must show only that account's contact.
  - Control: the same parent passed as a bare id sends the identical filter.
- Red before the fix: `expected '[object Object]' to be 'a1'`, the card's captured request reproduced (1 failed | 10 passed).
- Green after the fix: the five dependsOn / record-reference LookupField files pass, 39/39. The whole `ui/packages/fields/` suite passes at e19a6b25: Test Files 326 passed | 1 skipped, Tests 4982 passed | 7 skipped.
- Ablation, one run at e19a6b25 through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:
  - The mutation dropped `collapseReference(...)` from the memo and landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob c7c449f → 71cd8a0.
  - The new pin went red with `Received: "[object Object]"`.
  - The restore was verified: the blob equals HEAD's c7c449f and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The test imports `./LookupField` from source, so no dist rebuild was needed.

## Acceptance notes

- The `[object Object]` family the card names is in separate code. The kanban grouping (#36430) and the drill dialog (#36507) live in `plugin-kanban` / `plugin-dashboard`, and neither reads `dependentFilter` or `collapseReference`. They are not touched here.
- The gate check (`dependenciesMissing`) already treats a populated object as "present", so it needed no change.
- I kept the edit in the picker component to one line plus one import, because #36832 is also reworking the lookup picker.

## Verification

First file to read: `LookupField.tsx`, the `dependentFilter` memo. It is the only risky part of the change.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.dependsOn.test.tsx` should show 11 passed.
